properties.notes: Site owned by Melton Borough Council. In MBC's small sites study and considered a strong asset for development. No plans agreed for redevelopment, MBC currently assessing development options, expext some type of progress on site over 2018-19 period to give greater certainty over redevelopment of this particular site, advise to consult with regen team when next reviewed. A small part of the site, in the south western corner is leased from the Town Estate, on a 999 year lease from April 1870.
